description: This file defines the 'Formatter' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling number format string parsing and conversion to formatted output. It includes methods for interpreting Excel-like format strings, handling special formatting cases like dates, percentages, and text substitution, and managing different number sections based on the value (positive, negative, zero).

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: A class providing static methods to interpret and format number format strings similar to those used in Excel, including date, currency, percentage, and custom formats.

methods.name: splitFormatComparison
methods.description: Performs comparison between a value and a comparison value based on a condition operator, with default conditions.

methods.name: splitFormatForSectionSelection
methods.description: Determines the appropriate formatting section and color for a given value based on Excel-like multi-section formats.

methods.name: toFormattedString
methods.description: Converts a given value to a formatted string based on a provided format string, handling various Excel format features like dates, percentages, and text.
